g.text: Option Desk - Watch and completion loops are command instructions
spot, IV, regime, walls, RR, degradation
choose expiry, widen band or raise draws
Observation only. This command does not open,
mark or close a paper or real position.
Unavailable values are not numeric changes.
Six criteria: IV coverage, ladder size, walls/smile,
rankable plans, converged horizon, degradation reasons.
These are prompt instructions, not the LangGraph evaluator.
The host supplies recurrence and attempt limits.
Sources: .claude/commands/desk-watch.md and desk-complete.md. Commands depend on the host runtime for scheduling.
